summary: Third of eight ~60s raw screen-recording segments of Maude's Claude assistant working an IG 'MVP post' canvas: nearly the entire clip is a static hold on a pinned player photo while the assistant sidebar scrolls prose about identifying the right photo and planning an AI background-removal + score-mvp template step. The only real on-screen interaction is a brief View-menu hover around 46-52s. The five moments the brief is hunting for (auto background removal happening, template pick, slider edit, fast finished result, user iterating) are not visually demonstrated anywhere in this segment — by the clip's end the background-removal terminal command has only just been kicked off, with no rendered result yet. This segment reads as setup/talk, not payoff; the director should look to adjacent segments (likely 4th-6th of 8) for the actual before/after reveal and template/slider action.
